stem: Which of the following names the group best known for settling this region and states their reason for settling?

options.label: A
options.text: Merchants: To trade with the region’s American Indians

options.label: B
options.text: Quakers: To establish a colony free of slavery

options.label: C
options.text: Explorers: To map the region’s rivers

options.label: D
options.text: Puritans: To freely practice their religion
